text:
michelle_sales: Heads-up — AcmeGrid just dropped a hard procurement redline. They want an air-gapped POC (no external egress), HSM-backed BYOK, and a named SLA (99.95% uptime + 95th latency <150ms). Procurement wants signed terms by EOD Friday.

jordan_se: Air-gapped is new. We can do Private/on-prem but next-week POC looks tight. What exactly is in their redline?

michelle_sales: Uploaded redline: https://acmegrid-secure/dropbox/contract_redline_v2.pdf. Key pain points: data residency + indemnity tweaks + air-gap language + SLA. They also insist on SOC2 attestation and a runbook for maintenance.

ciso_jan: SOC2 package is ready. HSM/BYOK for cloud is straightforward (CloudHSM) but on-prem air-gap + HSM integration needs ops work and security review. We'll need eng + legal in the loop.

sre_lead: Short answer: we can't flip an air-gapped on-prem deployment this week. Realistic timeline to produce a hardened image and runbook is 2–3 weeks. SLA requires capacity commitment (dedicated nodes) or we can't guarantee 95th latency.

amy_engops: If they purchase reserved Dedicated capacity for the POC (dedicated pool sized to their throughput), we can provision and meet latency SLO. But that implies pricing changes and a provisional SLA with explicit caveats around maintenance windows.

legal_ops: Please share the annotated redline and list the clauses they will not budge on. We can fast-track review, but procurement counsel needs clear asks (indemnity caps, data residency language). If Sales marks what's critical we can escalate to outside counsel.

michelle_sales: Main non-negotiables per AcmeGrid: 1) absolute no egress during POC, 2) HSM BYOK with customer key control, 3) provisional SLA commitment in writing. They're escalating to their VP/Sr Procurement.

deploy-bot: New ticket created INF-7892 assigned to eng-ops; due 2025-03-12.

matt_se: I can join a technical call with AcmeGrid CISO & procurement tomorrow 10am PT. Jordan, can you prepare the network & ops checklist?

jordan_se: Yep — I'll prep a one-pager: network diagram, KMS options (BYOK via HSM or Redwood-managed KMS in isolated VPC), deployment model (air-gapped on-prem vs Private VPC), and SLA tradeoffs (reserved nodes vs best-effort). Also will include perf baseline numbers.

ciso_jan: For BYOK: cloud HSM is supported. For air-gapped on-prem we can integrate with customer HSM via PKCS#11 adapters but it requires manual provisioning windows and an ops runway. No phone-home means no automatic patching; need signed runbook and maintenance SLA.

amy_engops: Ops note: manual key provisioning + zero egress means no automated telemetry. We'll need an operator on their side for certain troubleshooting steps. We'll draft a runbook and exception list.

michelle_sales: Exec ask from AcmeGrid VP: can Redwood provide an exec-level note committing to prioritized support if they sign reserved capacity? They want a short message for their board.

rafael_sales: I can draft an exec note but need the precise yes/no for: (a) We will prioritize the POC, (b) we will provide a provisional SLA contingent on reserved capacity and legal signoff. @ceo_ping?

ceo_ping: I will send a brief note committing prioritized support, pending legal signoff and reserved capacity purchase. Need to see the exact phrasing legal approves.

legal_ops: Understood. Please surface which indemnity/data clauses are blockers and whether AcmeGrid will accept our standard DPA + SOC2 attestation. We aim to get an annotated redline back by EOD.

jordan_se: Quick technical caveat to include in exec note: 95th latency target depends on prompt size, seq length, and batch settings. We'll propose a capped batch policy and a max seq length to guarantee 150ms at 95th when on dedicated hardware.

michelle_sales: Action items (owners): 1) Legal produce annotated redline — legal_ops (EOD), 2) EngOps runbook + estimate — amy_engops (48h), 3) Exec note draft — rafael_sales + ceo_ping (ASAP), 4) Technical one-pager + perf baseline — jordan_se (tomorrow 9am PT), 5) Call with customer — matt_se (scheduled).

amy_engops: Acknowledged. Starting runbook draft now.

legal_ops: Acknowledged. Pulling contract and triaging clauses.

matt_se: Call invite sent to AcmeGrid CISO + Procurement for tomorrow 10am PT. Meeting link: https://meet.redwood/zoom/xyz

michelle_sales: Thanks everyone. If AcmeGrid agrees to reserve capacity up front, this will significantly reduce legal/ops risk and accelerate signoff. I'll update after the call. :point_up:

rafael_sales: Will coordinate exec note and loop CEO.

matt_se: Post-call update will go here.

michelle_sales: Merge status: open — we'll reconvene after legal redline and the call. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
